name: ceramics-storefront

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Catalog browsing, cart management, checkout, and the shopper's own order history/profile.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Shopper registration, sign-in, session, and password reset.

description: React SPA storefront where shoppers browse the ceramics catalog, manage a cart, check out with an integrated payment provider, and view their own order history and profile. Signs shoppers in via Thunder and calls ceramics-api for all catalog/cart/checkout/order data. Does not manage products, stock, or other shoppers' orders.
